career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Punjab are recruited as Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) in the Punjab Civil Service (Judicial Branch) under the Punjab Civil Services (Judicial Branch) Rules, 1951 (with amendments) and requisition from the Department of Home Affairs & Justice, Government of Punjab. Pay, allowances, and progression follow the uniform pay matrix of the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India (WP(C) 643/2015). Officers advance through Assured Career Progression (ACP) scale increments at 5-year intervals and cadre promotions through Senior Civil Judge / CJM and Additional District & Sessions Judge cadres up to the High Court of Punjab and Haryana.

exam_scheme.note: The Punjab Civil Service (Judicial Branch) Examination is conducted jointly by the Punjab Public Service Commission and the Hon'ble High Court of Punjab & Haryana in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening of 125 MCQs carrying 500 marks, 2 hours duration, with 0.20% / 1/5th negative marking), Main Written Examination (5 conventional narrative subjective papers of 3 hours each, 950 marks total), and Viva-Voce (100 marks). Final selection merit is prepared on the aggregate of the Main Written Examination and Viva-Voce (out of 1,050 marks). Qualifying thresholds require minimum 33% in each written paper, 33% in Punjabi, and 50% aggregate across written papers (45% for SC/BC/PwD candidates) to be called for Viva-Voce.

financial_package.note: Civil Judges (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrates in Punjab are compensated under the uniform pay structure recommended by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) and approved by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Officers enter at revised SNJPC Pay Scale Level J-1 (₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520; unrevised scale ₹27,700 - ₹44,770) with an entry basic pay of ₹77,840. Allowances are regulated by Punjab Government Law and Finance Department orders, including Dearness Allowance (58%), House Rent Allowance (or official rent-free judicial bungalow accommodation), Home Orderly / Domestic Help Allowance, Sumptuary Allowance, Electricity & Water Reimbursement, Robe Allowance, and Medical Reimbursement.
financial_package.pay_source_label: PPSC Advt. No. 2022103 General Information for Candidates & Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC)
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from SNJPC Level J-1 entry basic ₹77,840 + 58% DA (₹45,147) + judicial House Rent Allowance (HRA 16% to 24% or designated official judicial bungalow) + judicial sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance, and domestic help allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹12,299), Group Insurance Scheme (GIS), and Punjab Professional Tax.
official_perks: Designated independent judicial bungalow / official residence in the Judicial Officers' Colony of the posting district
Official staff car / conveyance facility with driver entitlement and monthly fuel allowance
Monthly sumptuary allowance and annual robe / dress maintenance allowance per SNJPC recommendations
Comprehensive cashless medical treatment and reimbursement for officer and dependent family members
Residential orderly / attendant allowance and reimbursement of domestic help charges
Reimbursement of electricity and water charges up to prescribed monthly units, plus official mobile and broadband facilities
Substantial judicial pension and gratuity entitlements under statutory judicial service rules
